issue_request: FHIR-14546 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I clarification asking what "appearances" meant in the profiling re-slicing rules and resolving to change "appearances" to "slices".

A later same-paragraph FHIR-14545 change clarified "name" to "ElementDefinition.sliceName" while preserving the FHIR-14546 "all slices of X" wording. Jira search surfaced earlier re-slicing clarification issues, but no later reversal; Zulip found only the tracker bot notice and Confluence found no references.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/profiling.html already contains the requested "all slices of X" wording at the relevant re-slicing bullets, and exact stale-wording search found no remaining "all appearances of X" text in the source tree.
